en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_desc: Under Chancellor Renn's watchful eye, Heir Corvin is undergoing intense training. Bad news brought by Captain Verne confirmed her fears: only a military action by the Heir himself can unite warring nations and put an end to Vex's plans.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t3: Keep it up! Only 90 more to go!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t5: This is not what I had in mind when I asked Chancellor for help...
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t7: At last, I really need to lie down.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t8: I see you are warmed up. Good. We can start with the main part then.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t10: I'm sorry, Heir, but time is not on our side.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t11: As you already know, Admiral Mori wasn't able to free your father. At this point, Chancellor Renn believes that there is only one way to defeat Commander Vex without an all-out war between Aurelian Holdings and other nations.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t12: Vex was never a big fan of diplomacy. He believes, that a pen might well be mightier than the sword, that is why he carries his grand halberd instead.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t13: As long as he commands Aurelian army, it's going to be hard to get rid of him. Your holdings needs you, Heir. More than ever before.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t14: Do you really believe I can achieve anything when even the greatest of the Aurora Concord commanders failed?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t15: Yes, you can. There are plenty of officers, who question orders coming from Vex. It's getting harder and harder for him to keep up the charade that Chairman is still in control. If they see you return, there is a great chance, that they will join your cause.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t16: If we can erode Vex's forces and allies, we can pressure him to surrender without causing too much damage.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t17: And speaking of loyal soldiers, some of them contacted us and agreed to come here to help you with your final test.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t18: Aurelian Holdings soldiers really came here for me? And what is this test?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t19: I've been overlooking your short, but intense training, and I must admit, your progress is commendable. Chancellor Renn believes you might be ready to face against Vex's armies.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t20: But before that happens, there will be one final test. And I will be the judge of whether you are fit or not to lead your soldiers back to Aurelian Bastion.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t22: The test is... also me. You will lead your troops against mine, in a mock battle.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t23: Your men are already waiting. They set up a camp on the eastern side of the training area.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t24: The goal of this encounter is to capture the HQ building. It is highly advisable to capture the other ones first, in order to diminish the defensive capabilities, but HQ is the one that counts.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t25: Expect me to be there as well, defending it.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t26: There are some structures in the middle as well.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t27: Those will be highly contested. Having them should give a big boost to whichever side controls them.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t29: No, but the loser is buying the drinks.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t30: You bet! Now let's get to our positions and we can start.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t32: So how did I do, Captain?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t33: There are things, that could have been done better, but overall I am impressed. I'll let Chancellor Renn know of your accomplishments. She is putting a lot of faith in you, and you did not disappoint.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t34: Thank you for your kind words! I think my soldiers need some rest.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t35: It was a hard day, for all of us. I guess today the drinks are on me, huh?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t36: Good thinking! Eliminating the opposing hero removes a lot of benefits for your enemy. I'll watch the remaining battle from the sidelines.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t37: I have been defeated... I wasn't ready after all...
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_desc: Accompanied by Captain Verne and a group of Dynastic Knights, Heir Corvin begins his march to rescue his father. His first objective is one of the border bases of Aurelian Holdings, where he hopes to enlist the help of one of the loyalist cohorts. But only when they arrive, the extent of Vex's corruption is revealed.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t2: Stand your ground! Let them come!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t3: Put your weapons down! These lands now belong to Commander Vex! You will either join us or perish trying to oppose us!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t4: Do you really think some lowly rebels can intimidate us? You are no match for the loyal Knights of the rightful Chairman!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t5: My Heir! There are Aurelian Holdings forces stationed down the road, but... they wear unusual uniforms.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t6: Hey, you! You're not allowed to be here! Identify yourselves!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t7: I am Corvin, an Aurelian Heir and a rightful heir to these lands! Who are you to stand in my way?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t8: Rightful heir? Good joke! Commander Vex is the one who rules this country now! And we, Ashfall Cell, are his army!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t9: And now, Heir, come with us. Commander will award us greatly for bringing you in! And while in chains, you will have the pleasure of watching us deal with a Commander who dared to defy our leader.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t10: It is an open rebellion then. Verne, prepare to fight!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t11: I figured it would come to that. These Ashfall Cell guys are over here as well. We can't reach you from here, but we will keep them occupied on this side.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t12: We will try to reach you and help if we can. We have to wipe them out. Capture all of their buildings!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t13: Also, it looks like they did not anticipate us being here. Their mission is to defeat a loyalist Commander defending the town. We can't let that happen.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t16: You're too late, Heir! Soon Commander will rule all of Aurelian Holdings!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t17: This is disturbing, to say the least. We should hurry!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t18: Yes, the sooner we get rid of Vex, the better.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t19: These guys are good! I'm afraid you are on your own now, I have to fall back.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t20: This victory means nothing! There will be others fighting for the Chairman!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_desc: Marshal Hale, released from unjust imprisonment, comes back for Operative Borel. But his old subordinate has a new master now. As it turns out, this particular business might not have been as good as Director Voss thought.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t1: Lieutenant Borel, I am ordering you to stand down. You have overstepped your authority, and for that, you will be tried.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t2: I'm afraid, General, that I'm no longer bound by your command.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t3: That makes you a traitor then, defecting to the enemy. What did Vex promise you?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t4: Once Commander Vex and his Ashfall Cell army take over the entire Aurelian Holdings, I will command them all. That's even better than a General!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t5: What a nice delusion you got there. I'm sure you'll have plenty of time to play it out in your head once we put you in a prison cell.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t6: And how exactly do you intend for that to happen, General?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t7: As you can see, you are surrounded. Once I defeat you, Commander Vex will be very pleased.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t9: It's time for me to go!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t10: I had to run again! Damn you, Hale! I hate this so much...
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t11: All units! Prepare to defend this position!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t12: Is that Marshal Hale? Looks like he's in a lot of trouble!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t13: Make haste! They need our help!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t15: Yes Heir, thanks to your timely intervention.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t16: First Aurelian Holdings, and now Meridian Combine soldiers joining Ashfall Cell. This is not good.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t17: What's even worse, as incompetent as Borel is, he is still a trained Commando, capable of causing serious damage.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t18: He slipped away again. I'm sure he'll run right back to Vex. We'll see him again.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t19: Don't worry, I'll take care of him. Now, let's see how I can help you in your fight against Commander Vex.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t20: That's too much! It's time to bail!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t22: I have made a tactical mistake! Fall back!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_desc: Following advice from Marshal Hale, Heir Corvin and his loyal soldiers are pushing north, looking for a way to encircle the Aurelian Bastion. Narrow valleys of the mountainous region ahead should help them stay undetected.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t1: So far, so good. It appears we have not been detected.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t2: Shame we had to leave the mechanised units behind, they would make too much noise.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t3: The enemy HQ is on the other side of the mountain range. Apparently, it is only lightly guarded. If we manage to capture it, the rest of the Ashfall Cell forces should surrender.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t4: First, we have to get through that valley. Infantry! Secure that route!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t5: Hold up! I think I heard something...
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t8: They were expecting us! Our cover is blown...
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t9: We will have to do this the old-fashioned way. Good thing we have enough air forces to deal with these launchers.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t10: We got them now! That fool of a Heir did not suspect anything! We have their flank!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t13: Hold on just a bit longer, Heir. We'll take care of them!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t14: Heiress Marchetti?! You should be in jail!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t15: I was lucky enough to get out early. And thanks to your Meridian and Aurora friends I have learned a thing or two.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t16: I can't blame you if you don't want to trust me, but I still want to help. Make things right.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t17: Well, I'm not in a position to say no. We can talk later.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t18: We'll have to do some construction first.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t19: I see you don't have your armoured units with you. Good thing I'm a master in that subject. You can use this Factory to bolster your forces.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t21: Heir was supposed to be a weakling! Commander will have our skins for this!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t22: Don't worry about that, he'll join you in prison soon enough!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t23: Well done, Heir! Let me support you in your future struggles.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t24: There is a tough battle ahead of us, your help will be hugely appreciated.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_desc: The standoff between Admiral Mori and Commander Vex continues. Besieged on all sides, he might not be able to hold out for much longer. Heir Corvin teams up with Captain Verne on a mission to support Aurora Concord forces under fire and free Chairman Aurelian.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t1: It seems like your grand plan is not going well, Vex. My dear friend Renn and her Aurora Concord soldiers are keeping you in check. I've also heard guards talking about imminent reinforcements.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t2: You can always surrender. I might even consider being merciful if you do.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t3: Don't get your hopes up, Your Majesty. I have all of the pawns exactly where I wanted them.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t4: Your son is here. Once my loyal soldiers take care of him on the battlefield, you will no longer be needed. After that, Aurelian Holdings will be no more. The eternal Ashfall Cell will begin!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t5: You're mad! But if Corvin is here... then he will end this for sure!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t7: Knights! Today is the day! It will not be easy, but it is our destiny!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t8: Our mission is to support our Aurora Concord allies led by Admiral Mori, defeat Ashfall Cell forces occupying the city, and save Chairman Aurelian!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t9: Admiral and his men are holding a strategic position, blocking one of the bridges leading into the city.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t10: They are, however, flanked by the enemy.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t11: We should support them as much as we can, but remember, that our main goal is the Aurelian Bastion.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t12: Captain Verne arrived with reinforcements as well. His camp is on the other side of the city.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t13: He has transferred the command of his troops to me, for better co-ordination.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t14: Together, we can secure the Admiral's flanks and put more pressure on Commander Vex.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t15: Our main objective is to claim three Towers surrounding the city centre.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t16: The first one is close to our position, we should be able to secure it once we get through the bridge.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t17: The second one is similarly close to a bridge, Verne should be able to take it.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t18: The middle one will be more difficult. Many streets are blocked off and fortified. We might have to find a way around it.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t21: That fight is too intense! Regroup in the HQ!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t22: We've got you surrounded, Vex! You have lost!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t23: Tell me, Vex. How are the 'pawns in place' going?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t24: Your scheme failed, Commander. You underestimated my son, and now you will pay for your transgressions!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t25: Oh, it's not over yet! Ashfall army grew big and strong right under your nose!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t26: You might have won today, but this is only temporary. You should celebrate while you still can.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t28: Don't worry, Father. We'll get him!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_name: In the name of the Chairman
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_desc: The final confrontation between Ashfall Cell and other nations draws near. Commander Vex returns to his castle hidden in the mountains, where his vast army awaits his command. Heir Corvin and his allies must band together and end his madness once and for all.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t1: The enemy is upon us! But we are strong! We will prevail!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t3: We will gather all of our forces, and then we will re-take Aurelian Bastion. This time, no one will stop us!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t6: Aurelian Holdings forces spotted to the north-west!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t7: We see some movement to the southwest as well!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t8: So they found us after all! Prepare for battle!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t10: A rat like you could not hide from me, Vex! Today, we will bring an end to your treachery!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t11: Do you really believe you can take on me, kid?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t14: I will provide you with air support!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t15: Greatly appreciated! And what about Captain Verne? I thought he would be here with you.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t16: I'm here as well, Heir. I would not miss such an opportunity!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t17: Since Admiral brought his air force only, Captain has agreed to support me in my Infantry assault, as this is more of his specialty, as well as mine.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t18: And Marshal Hale! So good to have you!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t19: This is all good, but looks like you could use some more firepower on the ground!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t20: Lucky for you, I have brought some!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t21: Aren't you getting ahead of yourself again, Marchetti?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t22: Are you here to arrest me again, Brandt?
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t23: Not this time. Your men told me you have departed to support Heir Corvin. I thought you could use some help yourself in this endeavour.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t24: It will be an honour to fight with you at my side.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t25: Everyone has united against you, Vex. Prepare to be defeated!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t28: They are breaking in, Sir! We can't stop them!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t29: You will stand your ground! Commander demands it!
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t31: Looks like it's time for us to go, Borel.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t32: It's not good, Sir. The escape route is blocked off.
en.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t33: I expected you would try sneaking away again. It's over, Vex. Now you will face justice. Take them away!

pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t3: Keep it up! Only 90 more to go!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t5: This is not what I had in mind when I asked Chancellor for help...
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t7: At last, I really need to lie down.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t8: I see you are warmed up. Good. We can start with the main part then.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t10: I'm sorry, Heir, but time is not on our side.

pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t32: So how did I do, Captain?
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t33: There are things, that could have been done better, but overall I am impressed. I'll let Chancellor Renn know of your accomplishments. She is putting a lot of faith in you, and you did not disappoint.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t34: Thank you for your kind words! I think my soldiers need some rest.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t35: It was a hard day, for all of us. I guess today the drinks are on me, huh?
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t36: Good thinking! Eliminating the opposing hero removes a lot of benefits for your enemy. I'll watch the remaining battle from the sidelines.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m1_t37: I have been defeated... I wasn't ready after all...
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_desc: Accompanied by Captain Verne and a group of Dynastic Knights, Heir Corvin begins his march to rescue his father. His first objective is one of the border bases of Aurelian Holdings, where he hopes to enlist the help of one of the loyalist cohorts. But only when they arrive, the extent of Vex's corruption is revealed.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t2: Stand your ground! Let them come!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t3: Put your weapons down! These lands now belong to Commander Vex! You will either join us or perish trying to oppose us!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t4: Do you really think some lowly rebels can intimidate us? You are no match for the loyal Knights of the rightful Chairman!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t5: My Heir! There are Aurelian Holdings forces stationed down the road, but... they wear unusual uniforms.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t6: Hey, you! You're not allowed to be here! Identify yourselves!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t7: I am Corvin, an Aurelian Heir and a rightful heir to these lands! Who are you to stand in my way?
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t8: Rightful heir? Good joke! Commander Vex is the one who rules this country now! And we, Ashfall Cell, are his army!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t9: And now, Heir, come with us. Commander will award us greatly for bringing you in! And while in chains, you will have the pleasure of watching us deal with a Commander who dared to defy our leader.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t10: It is an open rebellion then. Verne, prepare to fight!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t11: I figured it would come to that. These Ashfall Cell guys are over here as well. We can't reach you from here, but we will keep them occupied on this side.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t12: We will try to reach you and help if we can. We have to wipe them out. Capture all of their buildings!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t13: Also, it looks like they did not anticipate us being here. Their mission is to defeat a loyalist Commander defending the town. We can't let that happen.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t16: You're too late, Heir! Soon Commander will rule all of Aurelian Holdings!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t17: This is disturbing, to say the least. We should hurry!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t18: Yes, the sooner we get rid of Vex, the better.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t19: These guys are good! I'm afraid you are on your own now, I have to fall back.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m2_t20: This victory means nothing! There will be others fighting for the Chairman!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_desc: Marshal Hale, released from unjust imprisonment, comes back for Operative Borel. But his old subordinate has a new master now. As it turns out, this particular business might not have been as good as Director Voss thought.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t1: Lieutenant Borel, I am ordering you to stand down. You have overstepped your authority, and for that, you will be tried.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t2: I'm afraid, General, that I'm no longer bound by your command.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t3: That makes you a traitor then, defecting to the enemy. What did Vex promise you?
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t4: Once Commander Vex and his Ashfall Cell army take over the entire Aurelian Holdings, I will command them all. That's even better than a General!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t5: What a nice delusion you got there. I'm sure you'll have plenty of time to play it out in your head once we put you in a prison cell.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t6: And how exactly do you intend for that to happen, General?
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t7: As you can see, you are surrounded. Once I defeat you, Commander Vex will be very pleased.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t9: It's time for me to go!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t10: I had to run again! Damn you, Hale! I hate this so much...
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t11: All units! Prepare to defend this position!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t12: Is that Marshal Hale? Looks like he's in a lot of trouble!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t13: Make haste! They need our help!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t15: Yes Heir, thanks to your timely intervention.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t16: First Aurelian Holdings, and now Meridian Combine soldiers joining Ashfall Cell. This is not good.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t17: What's even worse, as incompetent as Borel is, he is still a trained Commando, capable of causing serious damage.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t18: He slipped away again. I'm sure he'll run right back to Vex. We'll see him again.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t19: Don't worry, I'll take care of him. Now, let's see how I can help you in your fight against Commander Vex.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t20: That's too much! It's time to bail!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m3_t22: I have made a tactical mistake! Fall back!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_desc: Following advice from Marshal Hale, Heir Corvin and his loyal soldiers are pushing north, looking for a way to encircle the Aurelian Bastion. Narrow valleys of the mountainous region ahead should help them stay undetected.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t1: So far, so good. It appears we have not been detected.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t2: Shame we had to leave the mechanised units behind, they would make too much noise.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t3: The enemy HQ is on the other side of the mountain range. Apparently, it is only lightly guarded. If we manage to capture it, the rest of the Ashfall Cell forces should surrender.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t4: First, we have to get through that valley. Infantry! Secure that route!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t5: Hold up! I think I heard something...
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t8: They were expecting us! Our cover is blown...
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t9: We will have to do this the old-fashioned way. Good thing we have enough air forces to deal with these launchers.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t10: We got them now! That fool of a Heir did not suspect anything! We have their flank!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t13: Hold on just a bit longer, Heir. We'll take care of them!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t14: Heiress Marchetti?! You should be in jail!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t15: I was lucky enough to get out early. And thanks to your Meridian and Aurora friends I have learned a thing or two.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t16: I can't blame you if you don't want to trust me, but I still want to help. Make things right.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t17: Well, I'm not in a position to say no. We can talk later.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t18: We'll have to do some construction first.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t19: I see you don't have your armoured units with you. Good thing I'm a master in that subject. You can use this Factory to bolster your forces.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t21: Heir was supposed to be a weakling! Commander will have our skins for this!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t22: Don't worry about that, he'll join you in prison soon enough!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t23: Well done, Heir! Let me support you in your future struggles.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m4_t24: There is a tough battle ahead of us, your help will be hugely appreciated.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_desc: The standoff between Admiral Mori and Commander Vex continues. Besieged on all sides, he might not be able to hold out for much longer. Heir Corvin teams up with Captain Verne on a mission to support Aurora Concord forces under fire and free Chairman Aurelian.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t1: It seems like your grand plan is not going well, Vex. My dear friend Renn and her Aurora Concord soldiers are keeping you in check. I've also heard guards talking about imminent reinforcements.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t2: You can always surrender. I might even consider being merciful if you do.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t3: Don't get your hopes up, Your Majesty. I have all of the pawns exactly where I wanted them.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t4: Your son is here. Once my loyal soldiers take care of him on the battlefield, you will no longer be needed. After that, Aurelian Holdings will be no more. The eternal Ashfall Cell will begin!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t5: You're mad! But if Corvin is here... then he will end this for sure!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t7: Knights! Today is the day! It will not be easy, but it is our destiny!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t8: Our mission is to support our Aurora Concord allies led by Admiral Mori, defeat Ashfall Cell forces occupying the city, and save Chairman Aurelian!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t9: Admiral and his men are holding a strategic position, blocking one of the bridges leading into the city.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t10: They are, however, flanked by the enemy.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t11: We should support them as much as we can, but remember, that our main goal is the Aurelian Bastion.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t12: Captain Verne arrived with reinforcements as well. His camp is on the other side of the city.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t13: He has transferred the command of his troops to me, for better co-ordination.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t14: Together, we can secure the Admiral's flanks and put more pressure on Commander Vex.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t15: Our main objective is to claim three Towers surrounding the city centre.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t16: The first one is close to our position, we should be able to secure it once we get through the bridge.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t17: The second one is similarly close to a bridge, Verne should be able to take it.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t18: The middle one will be more difficult. Many streets are blocked off and fortified. We might have to find a way around it.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t21: That fight is too intense! Regroup in the HQ!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t22: We've got you surrounded, Vex! You have lost!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t23: Tell me, Vex. How are the 'pawns in place' going?
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t24: Your scheme failed, Commander. You underestimated my son, and now you will pay for your transgressions!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t25: Oh, it's not over yet! Ashfall army grew big and strong right under your nose!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t26: You might have won today, but this is only temporary. You should celebrate while you still can.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m5_t28: Don't worry, Father. We'll get him!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_name: In the name of the Chairman
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_desc: The final confrontation between Ashfall Cell and other nations draws near. Commander Vex returns to his castle hidden in the mountains, where his vast army awaits his command. Heir Corvin and his allies must band together and end his madness once and for all.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t1: The enemy is upon us! But we are strong! We will prevail!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t3: We will gather all of our forces, and then we will re-take Aurelian Bastion. This time, no one will stop us!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t6: Aurelian Holdings forces spotted to the north-west!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t7: We see some movement to the southwest as well!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t8: So they found us after all! Prepare for battle!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t10: A rat like you could not hide from me, Vex! Today, we will bring an end to your treachery!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t11: Do you really believe you can take on me, kid?
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t14: I will provide you with air support!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t15: Greatly appreciated! And what about Captain Verne? I thought he would be here with you.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t16: I'm here as well, Heir. I would not miss such an opportunity!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t17: Since Admiral brought his air force only, Captain has agreed to support me in my Infantry assault, as this is more of his specialty, as well as mine.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t18: And Marshal Hale! So good to have you!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t19: This is all good, but looks like you could use some more firepower on the ground!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t20: Lucky for you, I have brought some!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t21: Aren't you getting ahead of yourself again, Marchetti?
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t22: Are you here to arrest me again, Brandt?
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t23: Not this time. Your men told me you have departed to support Heir Corvin. I thought you could use some help yourself in this endeavour.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t24: It will be an honour to fight with you at my side.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t25: Everyone has united against you, Vex. Prepare to be defeated!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t28: They are breaking in, Sir! We can't stop them!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t29: You will stand your ground! Commander demands it!
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t31: Looks like it's time for us to go, Borel.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t32: It's not good, Sir. The escape route is blocked off.
pl.tr_core_amber_noon_m6_t33: I expected you would try sneaking away again. It's over, Vex. Now you will face justice. Take them away!
